Accounts payable

AP Payment Review

I built a training demo for accounts payable teams to review an invoice with a quantity mismatch and a change to the supplier's bank details.

Independent project

The problem

A fictional supplier billed for 100 units at $48 each, but the first goods receipt covers only 80. The remaining 20 units account for $960. The bank account on the invoice also differs from the verified account on file.

The decision

I used the same rule-based checks in the browser and command line. Three Agent Skills let Codex and Claude Code review invoice exceptions, check supplier account changes, and assemble an evidence pack.

What you can try

Start the guided tour and add the late receipt and the bank verification record one at a time. Each record clears one finding. Once both findings clear, the case is ready for a human approver. Export the evidence pack to see the decision and the records behind it.
